inurl:index.php: Restricts results to websites running on PHP homepages or scripts.
inurl:id=: Targets specific database entry IDs in the URL structure (common in dynamic web applications).
before:2023-01-01: Limits the indexed results to pages created or archived prior to 2023.

Publishing: When an author sells enough copies of a book to pay back their initial publisher advance before earning active royalties.

What the Search Operators Mean
earnout: Targets content discussing a financial arrangement where extra payments depend on future performance, or an author selling enough books to cover their advance.
inurl:index.php: Restricts results to websites running on PHP homepages or scripts.
inurl:id=: Targets specific database entry IDs in the URL structure (common in dynamic web applications).
before:2023-01-01: Limits the indexed results to pages created or archived prior to 2023.

Publishing: When an author sells enough copies of a book to pay back their initial publisher advance before earning active royalties.
